member.name: M:apiGLMS.Controllers.ContractsController.Update(System.Int32,apiGLMS.Models.Contract)
member.summary: Fully replaces an existing contract record with new data.
member.param: The primary key of the contract to update.
The replacement contract data (JSON). Must include the matching Id.
member.response: Update was successful; no body is returned.
No contract with that ID exists.

member.name: M:apiGLMS.Controllers.ContractsController.UpdateStatus(System.Int32,System.String)
member.summary: Updates only the Status field of a contract (e.g. approve or decline).
member.remarks:
Send the new status as a plain JSON string:
PATCH /api/contracts/7/status "Approved"
Common values: Draft, Active, Approved, Declined, Expired.

member.name: M:apiGLMS.Controllers.ContractsController.UpdateAgreementPath(System.Int32,System.String)
member.summary: Updates the SignedAgreementPath after the MVC layer has handled the physical file upload.
member.remarks:
The MVC app uploads the PDF, saves it to wwwroot/uploads, then calls this endpoint to persist the resulting path in the database.
PATCH /api/contracts/7/agreement-path "/uploads/abc123_signed.pdf"
member.param: The relative server path to the stored PDF.

member.name: M:apiGLMS.Controllers.ContractsController.Delete(System.Int32)
member.summary: Permanently removes a contract record from the database. Note: the associated PDF file (if any) must be deleted separately by the MVC layer.
member.param: The primary key of the contract to delete.
